sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2008 BMW M5, finished in Space Gray Metallic with a black interior. This M5 is equipped with the desirable 6-speed manual transmission. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this M5’s past. According to the build sheet pictured in the photo gallery, this M5 came equipped with Lights Package (adaptive xenon headlights), 19-inch Style 166M wheels, a sunroof, Merino leather upholstery, heated and power-adjustable front seats, aluminum interior trim, rear sunshades, a head-up display, and soft-close doors, among others listed below. The seller reports no modifications. Based on the E60-generation 5 Series, the fourth-generation M5 made its debut for the 2006 model year with a mighty V10 engine between its vented fenders. It followed its segment's shift towards technology and luxury by offering enthusiasts a longer list of equipment than its predecessor, including a "Power" button and configurable driving modes. Production ended in 2010, and BMW hasn't released another V10-powered M5 since. Power for this M5 comes from an "S85" 5.0-liter V10, rated at 500 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.
